paper_title: DraftAttention: Fast Video Diffusion via Low-Resolution Attention Guidance

innovative_points.title: Training-Free Dynamic Sparse Attention
innovative_points.description: First method to provide truly dynamic sparse attention patterns at per-module level without requiring any training or fine-tuning
innovative_points.technical_details: Uses low-resolution draft attention computed via average pooling to guide sparse patterns for each attention module independently
innovative_points.quality_impact: Maintains generation quality comparable to dense baseline

innovative_points.title: Low-Resolution Attention Guidance
innovative_points.description: Novel approach using downsampled query/key to compute draft attention maps that reliably approximate full attention
innovative_points.technical_details: 8×16 average pooling reduces tokens by 128× factor while preserving essential visual patterns

runtime_improvement.draft_computation: [n/128, k/128, n/128] = 1/16384 of full attention cost
runtime_improvement.guidance_overhead: Negligible compared to sparse attention savings

innovative_points.quality_impact: PSNR improvements of 3-6dB over SVG at same sparsity

innovative_points.title: Hardware-Friendly Token Reordering
innovative_points.description: Deterministic reordering algorithm that aligns region-level sparsity with GPU-optimized block processing
innovative_points.technical_details: Groups 8×16 spatial patches contiguously in memory for efficient block-wise computation

runtime_improvement.kernel_efficiency: Compatible with FlashAttention and Block Sparse Attention

innovative_points.quality_impact: No quality degradation, pure performance gain

innovative_points.title: Theoretical Error Bounds
innovative_points.description: First formal analysis quantifying approximation error from both pooling and sparsification in video diffusion
innovative_points.technical_details: Frobenius norm bounds: ‖S-S_draft‖_F ≤ δn and ‖S-S⊙˜M‖_F ≤ n(δ+t)√(1-r)
innovative_points.quality_impact: Provides confidence in quality preservation at high sparsity

improvement_proposals.title: Adaptive Pooling Kernels
improvement_proposals.description: Learn optimal kernel sizes per layer based on content characteristics instead of fixed 8×16
improvement_proposals.technical_implementation: Content-aware kernel selection with learned scaling factors α, β

runtime_improvement.improved: [n, k, n] → [n/α, k/β, n/α] where α,β ∈ [64,256]

improvement_proposals.quality_benefit: Better preservation of fine details, especially in high-motion regions

improvement_proposals.title: Layer-wise Dynamic Sparsity
improvement_proposals.description: Adaptive sparsity ratios based on layer importance and content complexity

runtime_improvement.improved: r_i varies per layer: early layers r=0.7, late layers r=0.95

improvement_proposals.quality_benefit: Allocate compute budget more efficiently, maintain quality

improvement_proposals.title: Motion-Aware Temporal Pooling
improvement_proposals.description: Adaptive pooling weights based on optical flow magnitude instead of uniform average
improvement_proposals.technical_implementation: Compute motion vectors between frames, weight pooling by motion magnitude

runtime_improvement.improved: Motion-guided sampling with variable temporal reduction

improvement_proposals.quality_benefit: Preserve temporal dynamics in high-motion sequences

improvement_proposals.title: Multi-Scale Draft Attention
improvement_proposals.description: Hierarchical draft attention at multiple resolutions for better pattern capture
improvement_proposals.quality_benefit: Capture both local and global attention patterns

improvement_proposals.title: Hybrid Attention Mechanism
improvement_proposals.description: Combine sparse and dense attention based on content importance scores
improvement_proposals.technical_implementation: Learn mixture weights α ∈ [0,1] for sparse vs dense attention

runtime_improvement.baseline: Pure sparse attention with fixed sparsity
runtime_improvement.improved: α·[n, k*r, n] + (1-α)·[n, k, n] with learned α

improvement_proposals.quality_benefit: Maintain quality for complex scenes while accelerating simple ones

draft_attention.stage2_sparse: [n, k×r, n] where r is sparsity ratio
